english: Killing enemies of the <link Elite Tier or higher [#CombatantClassifications] /> grants 'Unstable Essence' for 15 seconds, granting 30 Melee and Grenade stats. Further qualifying kills refresh the buff duration.

source.text:
2 Piece | Nightmarish Power

Upon scoring an Elite+ Kill:
Grants Unstable Essence for 15 seconds.
Scoring additional Elite+ Kills refresh the buff duration.

Unstable Essence | +30 Melee Stat and +30 Grenade Stat.
